summary: Millennium Group International Holdings Ltd., through its subsidiary Millennium Strategic International Limited, agreed on August 27, 2026, to sell all shares of Millennium Printing International Limited to Yee Cheong (1926) Enterprise Company Limited, a related party whose ultimate shareholders own ~88.89% of the company. Cash purchase price is HKD 14.8 million (~USD 1.9 million). Concurrently, Yee Cheong assumes HKD 35.43 million of intercompany liabilities, partly offset by loans and deferred cash payments. Audit committee approved; disinterested directors voted. Completion subject to regulatory approvals. Watch for related-party fairness and closing conditions.
